raw_text: React directives (not Next.js-specific): `"use client"` marks Client Components; required for React hooks, event handlers, and browser APIs. `"use server"` marks Server Actions, passable to Client Components. `"use cache"` marks functions/components for caching; requires `cacheComponents: true` in `next.config.ts`. See `next-cache-components` skill for cache profiles, `cacheLife()`, `cacheTag()`, `updateTag()`. References: https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-server https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/directives/use-cache
